title: 第二十三章 手机录像第二十四章 给嫂子按摩
content_zh:
“行。”等再抬起头，李玉梅冲王大壮笑了笑，眼眶红红的，“嫂子听你的。”
王大壮这才满意地点了点头，大口大口地扒起饭来。
他今天确实饿坏了，从早上到现在就啃了两个凉馒头，这会儿饭菜入口，简直是人间美味。
李玉梅今天做的菜也比平时丰盛，除了腊肉炒蒜苗，还有一盘番茄炒蛋和一碟子凉拌黄瓜，虽然都是家常菜，可在王大壮嘴里，比什么山珍海味都好吃。
“嫂子，你做的饭真好吃。”王大壮含糊不清地夸了一句，嘴里塞得满满的。
李玉梅被他这副吃相逗笑了，嗔了一句道：“慢点吃，没人跟你抢。”
她端起碗，小口小口地吃着，目光却时不时地落在王大壮身上。
他今天穿的那件白色背心被汗水浸湿了又干，干了又湿，领口和腋下都泛着一圈白色的汗渍，露在外面的手臂和肩膀被太阳晒得黝黑，肌肉线条在灯光下格外分明。
她忽然想起今天在竹林里埋掉的那些东西，心跳不自觉地加快了几分，脸颊泛起一层淡淡的红晕，连忙低下头去，假装专心吃饭。
吃完饭，李玉梅收拾碗筷去灶房洗，王大壮打了一桶井水提到院子角落里那个简易的淋浴棚里冲了个凉。
井水冰凉，浇在身上让王大壮打了个激灵，一天的疲惫被冲刷掉大半，整个人神清气爽。
冲完澡，他擦着湿漉漉的头发走进堂屋，李玉梅已经收拾完了，正在灶房里烧水准备自己洗。
王大壮跟她说了声“嫂子我先睡了”，就进了自己那间紧挨着灶房的小卧室。
卧室很小，只有一张木板床和一张旧桌子，墙上糊的报纸已经发黄发脆，有些地方脱落了露出里面的土坯。
床上的被褥虽然旧，但洗得很干净，叠得整整齐齐，上面还散发着阳光晒过的味道——李玉梅今天肯定把他的被子拿出去晒了。
王大壮躺在床上，从口袋里掏出那部林婉仪送的手机，在手里翻来覆去地看了看。
黑色的机身，屏幕很大，虽然林婉仪说是旧手机，可他怎么看都觉得跟新的一样。
他打开手机翻了翻，里面除了林婉仪存的号码，什么都没有，干干净净的，像是一张白纸。
他把玩了一会儿，设置了一个密码锁，然后把手机放到枕头底下，闭上眼睛准备睡觉。
可他怎么也睡不着。

隔壁灶房里传来哗啦哗啦的水声，是李玉梅在洗澡。
那声音隔着一堵薄薄的土墙传过来，清晰得像是近在咫尺。
王大壮翻了个身，把脸朝向墙壁，闭上眼睛，可耳朵却不听使唤地竖了起来，捕捉着隔壁的每一个声响。
水声，脚步声，衣物的窸窣声。
王大壮的呼吸不自觉地变得粗重起来。
就在这时，他的目光无意中落在墙壁上——那面紧挨着灶房的土墙上，靠近床头的位置，有一个拳头大小的破洞。
那破洞是被雨水冲垮的，以前他是傻子的时候从不在意，可现在……
王大壮咽了口唾沫，脑子里有两个声音在打架。
一个声音告诉他不能看，那是他嫂子，这是不尊重。
另一个声音却像魔鬼一样在他耳边低语，说就看一眼，一眼就好。
最终，魔鬼赢了。
王大壮缓缓地把头挪到那个破洞旁边，眼睛贴了上去。
content_en:
"Okay." When she raised her head again, Li Youmei smiled at Wang Dazhuang, her eyes red, "Sister-in-law, I will listen to you."
Wang Dazhuang nodded with satisfaction and took big mouthfuls of rice.
He was really hungry today. He had eaten two cold steamed buns since morning. Now the food tasted like a delicacy in the world.
The dishes Li Youmei cooked today were also richer than usual. In addition to fried bacon and garlic sprouts, there was also a plate of scrambled eggs with tomatoes and a plate of cold cucumbers. Although they were all home-cooked dishes, in Wang Dazhuang's mouth, they tasted better than any other delicacies from the mountains and seas.
"Sister-in-law, the food you cook is so delicious." Wang Dazhuang praised vaguely, his mouth full.
Li Youmei laughed at the way he was eating, and said angrily: "Eat slowly, no one will compete with you."
She picked up the bowl and ate in small bites, but her eyes fell on Wang Dazhuang from time to time.
The white vest he wore today was soaked with sweat, dried and wet again. There was a circle of white sweat stains on the collar and armpits. His exposed arms and shoulders were tanned by the sun, and his muscle lines were particularly clear under the light.
She suddenly remembered the things she had buried in the bamboo forest today, and her heart beat faster unconsciously. A faint blush appeared on her cheeks, and she quickly lowered her head, pretending to concentrate on eating.
After eating, Li Youmei packed up the dishes and went to the kitchen to wash them. Wang Dazhuang took a bucket of well water and took a shower in the simple shower shed in the corner of the yard.
The cold well water gave Wang Dazhuang a jolt when he poured it on his body. Most of the fatigue of the day was washed away, and he felt refreshed.
After taking a shower, he wiped his wet hair and walked into the main room. Li Youmei had already finished cleaning up and was boiling water in the kitchen to wash herself.
Wang Dazhuang said to her, "Sister-in-law, I'm going to bed first," and then entered his small bedroom next to the kitchen.
The bedroom was small, with only a wooden bed and an old table. The newspapers on the walls had become yellow and brittle, and had fallen off in some places to reveal the adobe inside.
Although the quilt on the bed was old, it was washed clean and neatly folded. It still smelled like it had been dried by the sun - Li Youmei must have taken out his quilt to dry it today.
Wang Dazhuang lay on the bed, took out the mobile phone given by Lin Wanyi from his pocket, and looked at it over and over in his hand.
It had a black body and a large screen. Although Lin Wanyi said it was an old phone, he felt it was just like new.
He opened his phone and flipped through it. There was nothing in it except the number saved by Lin Wanyi. It was as clean as a piece of white paper.
He played with it for a while, set a password lock, then put the phone under his pillow, closed his eyes and prepared to sleep.
But he couldn't sleep.
The sound of rushing water came from the kitchen next door. It was Li Youmei taking a bath.
The sound came through a thin earth wall, as clear as if it was very close at hand.
Wang Dazhuang turned over, faced the wall, and closed his eyes, but his ears stood up uncontrollably, catching every sound next door.
The sound of water, footsteps, and the rustling of clothes.
Wang Dazhuang's breathing became heavier unconsciously.
At this moment, his eyes accidentally fell on the wall - on the earthen wall next to the kitchen, near the head of the bed, there was a hole the size of a fist.
The hole was washed away by the rain. When he was a fool, he never cared about it, but now...
Wang Dazhuang swallowed, and there were two voices fighting in his head.
A voice told him he couldn't look, it was his sister-in-law and it was disrespectful.
Another voice whispered in his ear like a devil, saying just take a look, just take a look.
In the end, the devil won.
Wang Dazhuang slowly moved his head to the hole and pressed his eyes against it.
